reviews.text: They groomed my westie exactly how we told them.  Highly recommend
Milo loves Pet Parlour.  The staff are kind and conscientious. People always comment on our toy poodle.  Pet Parlour always does a great job,
Just picked our pooch and she was glowing, very tidily groomed and ready to get on with her life in style.

Friendly and caring and very knowledgeable staff. They treat our furry loved ones as their own. We love their selection of treats. Their groomers take extra care of our little one who is very timid around others so we can leave him with confidence. Thank you everyone at the store.

Good hair cut
Wanted a few touch ups which they did with no problem!
Chalky loves pet parlour!!!
They always do the best job and my nervous kitty is more comfortable each time!

Took my dog to get groomed here after struggling to find a good groomer. Really impressed with the service we got and the exceptional grooming job done on my cumbersome labradoodle. Very satisfied and highly recommend Pet Parlor.

My mom brought my dog in and we live super close to this groomer so we walked my dog there and my dog had no scratches on her paw whatsoever, when we got my dog, back the lady gives her back with a huge scratch to the bone on her paw, it was bleeding and my dog was wimping because it was so bad so then they had to put a bandage and a cone. My dog was almost 15 years old super old. We had to put her down three days later because she was in so much pain. I will never be returning here ever again.
Very nice place and friendly people being going for years
we boarded our dog with pet parlor and they did a fantastic job. She was happy and Healthy.
My toy yorkie looks amazing! This was his first haircut, they really took care of him and did a great job. Staff was professional and polite.
Friendly, family run place. My doodle gets his haircuts there and be seems to love going to visit his friends at daycare.

the Pet Parlous is fantastic and have done a fabulous job trimming my dogs nails.  I have a small little maltese cross who can be pretty difficult.   I feel confident and comfortable every time i bring him to Pet Parlour.  couldn’t recommend this place enough!

I’ve been getting my Persian cat Eloise groomed  at Pet Parlour for over six years! Victor and Patricia are excellent every time in service and quality of the groom. I can’t recommend Pet Parlour highly enough!
Watson received a lovely hair cut and looks and smells amazing 🤩
My cat’s first grooming treatment by Patricia. Great service!
Calm, attentive staff, great with dogs

I was having a really hard time finding a groomer that would take my senior cat and get her mats out. Pet Parlor booked me in right away, my cat was taken care of and she looks great! We will be back :)
Always a quick and easy trip for my cats!
Great groomer. Always happy with their service and attention to detail.

Front counter was pleasant and had Fonzie  clipped and happy in 15 minutes.
He actually came out happier than when he went in.
Great, friendly service and our miniature schnauzer leaves happy and her cut always looks amazing!
We have been taking our dog to Pet Parlour for years. They have always been great in taking care of our dog. Their grooming skills are excellent and we always get good results.

Thank you for making my pups first Pawdicure a very good experience.
Quick & easy….

They are the best most gentle loving groomers ever
My sweet pup , Sunny ,
loves it there ..
she has intensely dislikes going to groomers
Until we found Pet Parlour on Cambie & 18th
Yeah to their gentle approach !!thank you Patricia and family !!!‼️💗💗💗
A great place to take your pet to be taken care of.  Friendly, helpful, and very attentive to your furry family member.
I love bringing my dog to Pet Parlour. He’s a big, strong dog and they handle him great! He always comes out fluffy and smelling delightful!

My dog and I Iove and highly recommend Pet Parlour!  We have been regular customers for 6 years for all her nutrition and treats, grooming and day care. This is a family owned and operated company where the whole family and nice staff take care of our beloved pets.
Ive been taking my cat to get groomed for years here! Everyone's always so nice and accommodating.

I had a wonderful experience at Pet Parlour! The staff was warm, professional, and made my dog feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. They did an excellent job with the grooming, and my pup came back looking clean, fluffy, and happy. I really appreciated the attention to detail and the genuine care they showed throughout the visit. The salon was clean, well-organized, and the service was completed on time. It's easy to see why so many pet owners trust this place. I highly recommend Pet Parlour to anyone looking for high-quality grooming and friendly service. We'll definitely be returning!
Thank you for taking care of my troublesome chihuahua who hates getting his mani-pedi
Courteous, quick and easy service grooming for my companion Sacha, will use your service again

After repeatedly sharing that my dog had hip issues, I watched as they handled his legs aggressively, with no care, until he yelped.

Because everything here is behind closed doors, I would’ve never known… but luckily they left the door open and I could see how they were treating him.

I immediately asked for my dog and left.

When you leave your dog in someone else’s care, you expect them to give the most basic love, care and attention.

This place does not do that.

It’s so busy and chaotic, they take on too many dogs at once and completely disregarded everything I said about my dog.

For other dog owners I would 100% avoid, instead I’d recommend…

1. Seeking a groomer where the grooming area is open and visible so you can see how your dog is being treated

2. Find a place that doesn’t groom/house 10+ dogs at a time where yours gets lost in the mixed

3. Use mobile groomer that comes to you and gives individual care

I will never come back here and will be telling all my fellow dog owners to avoid as well.

Pup always happy to

Shitty job

This was my first time using a cat grooming service, and I was pleasantly surprised. My cat got a lion cut, a bath, and even nail trimming (all included). Amazingly, my cat seemed calm there, and I’ll definitely return for the same great experience!

Milo looks great.  We were worried how we would look after being sheared, but he looks and feels great.
thanks again- great as usual.
Great groom for our dog, and friendly, professional service. Will take him back for his next cut.

The girls did a great job on my cat Oliver! I was not expecting them to be able to give him a bath and a full groom including a great teddy bear cut!
They took the time to discuss with what we wanted them to do for him and when I returned to pick him up, he was calm, happy and looked amazing! Great service and great price💪 …
Always very friendly and tremendous service with loving staff
my dog looks wonderful .. the service is great..
Our standard poodle looked great after you groomed her. Good attention to details like ears, under the tail and paws and maintaining a very sleek body.
Our girl cat was very happy with the outcome!
I love all the staff.
the lovely staff takes great care of Moose, honestly they give him the perfect nail trim.

I took my Border Collie to Pet Parlour and couldn't have been happier with my experience. I popped in to make the appointment - a very friendly gal helped me out and answered any questions I had. They made sure to get a full picture of what I needed done and actually went as far as to call me after I had dropped her off to double check a couple of things. She was there for about two hours and came out looking like a show dog. Cost was just under 80 bucks for wash/cut/nails. This was my first time getting my dog groomed and they made me (and her!) feel completely at ease. Recommended!

This was my first time taking my son to this grooming shop. Initially, they quoted me 80 baht, showing me a picture of the style I wanted. My usual groomer was closed, so I decided to give this one a try. They said they could do it and it would take 2-3 hours. However, it actually took almost 6 hours to groom my son, and they charged me 120 baht, which was completely different from the initial price. The time spent was also a major issue; when I went to pick up my son, the staff made me wait another hour. This was completely unprofessional for a grooming job that took 6-7 hours. My son's fur looked terrible, nothing like the picture. This was the worst, longest, and most expensive grooming experience I've ever had. I believe it was all a scam. I strongly advise against using this shop As you can see from the two pictures above, that's my regular groomer charging $70, and the picture below is from this shop charging $120. It took almost seven hours to cut my dog's fur, and it looks terrible.
Great service and flexibility.  Grooming has been very good and we appreciate the personal service. Victor and Team are great! We have been with them for many years.
Always a pleasure going there. Such friendly and helpful staff. Gentle and loving with our pets. Also nice to get tips from staff. Love this place.
Great people... Solid pet food

I’ve been a customer since Pet Parlour was first located on Fraser st and was very happy with the service until my last couple of visits. They did a terrible job on my dogs nail trim definitely not worth $26.
They were great with my disabled cat! Very great price and we’re very patient. They listened to everything I wanted to get done to help him and did a great job.
Super pleased with the attention Lucy receives and she's always so excited when she sees everyone 💫 …
We've been going to Pet Parlour for a few years now.  We always get a great haircut.  Great pup snacks and coats too.
Took a long time but my dog now looks so cute I can’t stop looking at him
This place is amazing. I have been taking my Pomeranian there for years and they know how to give him the perfect cut every time. They also have extremely friendly service and fair prices.
Very consistent and listen well to directions.

We have taken our dog to the Pet Parlour for many years and Victor and his team do such amazing work.  We feel confident and know that our beloved dog is in good hands.  Thank you for always taking such good care of Stroodle.
Always great service to book. And my 15 year old golden always comes out looking incredible and happy.

We’ve been taking our baby dog, Sully, here for the last few years & the team takes such good care of him! We appreciate the attention and care that they give our pup. I’m grateful for the sweet and warm energy they welcome us with because Sully has attachment issues so it’s nice to leave him in their space. We are especially ecstatic about Sully’s most recent groom. He looks like the distinguished gentleman that he is. When we arrived to pick him up he was calmly and happily waiting, looking like perchance he spent the day at the spa. We greatly appreciated the attention to Sully’s lumps n bumps he’s developing and checking in with us bout them. Thank you so much <3

I knew right away when walking in my cat was in good hands. Friendly and helpful. I believe it was Gabriele that did my cat's nail trim the last time and she did an amazing job! My favorite go to place for kitty kat!
Always a pleasure! Now home for his treat💜 …
I absolutely love this place. The staff are so friendly. They all love my dog, and she loves them all back. They always do a great job grooming my dog. And they have very good rates.
Very friendly staff, my dog is always well groomed.
Absolutely love Pet Parlour! I've been taking my dog here for years. The team is wonderful and my dog struts out of there, every time, looking great and stress-free! I highly recommend this place!

Victor is super nice and accommodating.
My mom’s cat needed a long over due nail trim. He was able to allocate time same day.
Cat is all happy now, thank you so much Victor! 👍🏼🙏🏼
I drive from White Rock to Pet Parlour because Victor and Patricia do such an amazing job of grooming my sheltie.
Great service and excellent work!
They do a great job with our mini cockapoo. He is not scared when we get there before an appointment which is a good sign too!
Wonderful place! Very kind staff.
Great place to take care of your dog’s grooming.

I was so nervous bringing my cat monkey to the groomers for his very first time and the staff were so lovely and kind! I could tell right away that they were all animal lovers and that monkey would be well taken care of. His groom looks great, smells fresh and no more mats! Wonderful job! I will definitely be going here for all of monkeys future grooming needs!

My dog can be a bit of a handful and has gotten a little snippy at other grooming places in the past. But at this location, the team was incredibly professional and gentle with her. She was completely at ease and didn't show any aggression because they were just so good at what they do. They took care of her for about an hour and a half, and she came back not only smelling better than ever in her five years, but also in a better mood than I've seen her in a long time. These folks are truly excellent!
Pet Parlour is the best! We’ve been taking our little guy here for years and they always do a fantastic job ❤️
Came for a quick nail cut and they did the service well including the dew claw that always gets missed on my pup!
On time start for appointments, professional and friendly staff and owners. Locally owned. Reasonable prices.

Well, this has been the first time I’ve had a weird/unhappy experience with this parlour. They took about 4.5/5 hours to finish. They wouldn’t even give me an ETA for pickup time when I dropped him off.. Before I picked him up, I called to check in to see if he was close to being ready about 3 hours in and they said they needed another hour and a half. And had also said they were drying him off. When all he was suppose to get was a shave down and his trim.
He came back with multiple cuts and came back stinking of wet dog which was very gross.
He was very very upset and traumatized when I finally got him home with him . I won’t be returning.
My go to place for Kitty Kat's nail trim.  They do an excellent job and provide friendly service. You can tell their staff love animals.  I highly recommend for nail trim.
Took Lou in for a nail trim. It was fast and the best job done! Thank you, Pet Parlour!
Really happy with their services. Efficient, do a good job and very affordable.

One of the rare groomers in Vancouver who are capable of handling cats! I’ve taken mine here a handful of times now — the staff are all super friendly, they’re very accommodating with scheduling, and always do a great job on my cat’s coat and nails. My cat was in and out within 30 minutes today for a sanitary, pad, and nail trim, and a full brush out.

Best service , I have been going to this place ever since he opened it and I wouldn’t change it for anything, I have two long hair chihuahuas Rosie and Macho ,  and that’s the place to go whenever you need grooming or pampering they come back happy and smelling amazing . Thank you Victor .
Perfect every time. He comes out so adorable
Did a great job on Wilford! And not bad prices too!

Victor and the Pet Parlour team are incredible. I have been taking my cat (Balinese) Loki to them for about 5 years now. Such a friendly and welcoming environment and they always take care of Loki so well. He always comes out looking so handsome. So happy I was able to find a place that grooms cats, not of lot of places like this available. I would highly recommend the Pet Parlour!

Extremely expensive, my dog is always there for the entire day, and there is no transparency around pricing or why the price is constantly increasing for the exact same service. Unfortunately I will be finding a new groomers for my two dogs.
Please use something to blow-dry the hair after you’re done. I’m still coughing.
Great friendly staff. Lovely grooming . Excellent care!

I used to get my dog groomed here when Jina worked here. The service was always fantastic! Unfortunately, since she has left my dog has been left with Patricia and Victor, and my dog has since had a terrible experience. It’s unfortunate that this has happened.
My dog always looks great after being groomed.
Friendly staff and personalized service! They are very accommodating and easy to work with for scheduling appointments/pickups. Always a great experience for us and the cats!

I took my cat Babu for a bath, nail clipping, and bum trim. He came back smelling nice with good trim and all tidied up. He looks more relaxed and his fur is so soft. I would definitely take Babu again for a second bath and tidy visit.

Lovely people and fantastic service! They always fit me in last minute to get my cats claws trimmed. Am very thankful to have them in my neighborhood so I don't have to attempt trimming her claws myself 😂 …

I always bring my mini-poodle here for grooming. The team is professional, skilled, friendly and patient with Kimchi. My dog always comes back looking and smelling amazing and most importantly, she’s happy. As a longtime customer, I appreciate the team’s consistency and care. I highly recommend them to furparents who want top-notch grooming with personal touch.

They now carry dog food brands with free dog grooming promo.

Just letting you know it's wonderful your feeding the hummingbirds but your feeders are frozen.  It will dilute the sugar. You may have to bring them inside your store evening times until cold snap is over. 🦮 …

I’ve been a customer since 2019 and I can’t praise Patricia, Victor & the Pet Parlour team enough. They are so loving and kind to all my dogs. When my dog Ella passed way, they were so compassionate and understanding. With both my rescue dogs, they were gentle, understanding and so loving and patient with them. Absolutely incredible customer service and I love their grooming!!! My girls are always groomed to perfection and look so beautiful and happy!! I’ve also done their doggy daycare and it was wonderful! Pet Parlour was able to help me out last minute when I had a medical appointment. They also are very knowledgeable and have provided helpful advice to me too! If you’re looking for a groomer or new day care, highly recommend! And they also have so many cute dog toys, leashes, grooming, high quality food supplies and gift ideas too!

I don’t believe they can do cats as advertised. They seems very hesitant to take the cat at check in and looking for excuses to refuse him even though I had booked him and gave all the details. At the end they phoned me at home a few minutes after drop off saying he was aggressive and they can’t do it
Come and take him home….

My dog was nearly killed yesterday. Don't send your dog to this unsafe business.
If I could give 0 stars I would.
My 16 year old shih-tzu was groomed here Jan 11. She was left unattended on a table with a grooming leash around her neck. She was found hanging by a different employee, who  ran her over to the vet for assessment. She was initially unresponsive, but thankfully is now doing okay.
Speaking with the owner today, they were unable to tell me why this happened - just said the groomer turned around and then she fell (not the 1st hand story). They were unable to tell me how they would prevent this from happening again - clearly not a priority for them. They also failed to apologize or even acknowledge the horrible incident.
Disgusting. No care for animals. No remorse.

Our bernedoodle had been here a few times to see Victor with no problems, but then during his most recent visit he came out severely distressed (much more than just the typical post groom reaction). Victor was no where in sight at drop off or pick up even though we specifically booked with him, so I have to assume that he was not the one who handled my dog. That was 6 months ago and unfortunately my dog has not been the same since. He went from being the kind of dog that would play with any dog at the dog park, to suddenly being scared of all new dogs and incredibly anxious in new situations. I spend 24/7 normally with him, so I can only use process of elimination to assume that something horrible happened to him at Pet Parlour since that has been the only time I haven't been with him. The worst part is that when I picked him up and asked them how things went, they just said "fine" and nothing else. Meanwhile my dog is permanently scarred from something that happened due to the carelessness of an employee there. I reached out to them recently to explain what had happened so they were aware of the lasting effects, and I received no response back. They keep dogs there for 6-7 hours for a groom (for a 55lb doodle) which seems insane to me and you don't actually get to know who is grooming your dog or whats going on behind their closed doors. I think if your dog is completely neutral to the grooming experience then it's probably fine to take them there, but if your dog has any sort of anxieties or fears around grooming, I would definitely avoid.

We took our 5 month old Irish wolfhound/standard poodle mix here for a nail trim and paw pad tidy in November. We dropped him off and were told to return within 20 minutes to get him, however, when we got back, we were told they weren't finished. It took about 40 minutes overall, at one point the person at the desk was called in to help and I could hear my dog whining from outside. When they brought him out he was visibly stressed and panting. Since then, my dog will not let anyone trim his nails or go near his paw pads, before visiting Pet Parlour he had been to the vet tech and another groomer for trimming and there was no issue. I don't know for sure what happened but given how stressed my dog now is I have a suspicion the staff pinned him down in order to complete the process. I didn't realize they weren't fear free until the day of and should have trusted my gut about this place but unfortunately, the damage is now done. I think the staff here didn't have experience with giant breed puppies and handled my dog like a misbehaving adult and not a scared 5 month old. I'm very upset that my dog is now terrified of nail trims and won't be taking him here again.

Day care location is convenient to get to and the price is similar to other locations...but the ratio to staff to pets is a bit off and don't give great updates on how my puppy did. My other complaint is that my puppy seems to always be dehydrated when I pick him up. I've talked to other owners and they seem to agree with this as well. For those reading this and have a small dog, maybe consider other places, such as Petite Paws or Fetching Forever.

As for grooming...they do an ok job, but tend to add a lot of additional costs. And only was able to breakdown the total after I specifically requested it (after asking a number of times). I've also heard from others that they do hit your pet while grooming to make them obedient. Definitely not a place I will bring here ever again.

TLDR: pet abuse is not ok, and my puppy doesn't like it here.

P.S. - when having any concerns try to talk to Victor. If the other owner Patricia...avoid (she can't take any feedback, nor is she professional at all).

Victor and his staff always do an amazing job with grooming my Australian Shepherd. They’re well aware of the breed’s special undercoat and how to trim it properly.

We also regularly send our dog in for their doggy daycare. Their staff are all great, well-trained and regularly take the dogs out for walks around the neighbourhood during the day and they provide a little personalized “report card” of how your pooch did. Highly recommended.

Their shop is also full of well-curated dog products. I’ve included a photo of our Piper getting fitted with some Canada Pooch doggy boots with suspenders

To keep this short, I used to take my dog for daycare here but the owner, Patricia, became very hostile after I told her we started working with a reputable trainer in Vancouver. She kept telling me the trainer has bad techniques and she has better training methods that work, yet she could not tell me that her methods and beliefs were until I asked several times, and why I should work with her (at the time there was also nothing about it on their website). She also claimed my dog would not go for walks, but perhaps he was afraid of the cars and trucks in the laneway? If Patricia is also a dog trainer, did she give my dog positive reinforcement and read his body language to decide how to handle the situation?
I've never met such an unpleasant business owner, it was so unprofessional. She made many claims and assumptions about me and my spouse that I no longer wanted to give them my business. I will not recommend this place. If you've had to deal with Patricia, you will know what I'm talking about.

I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Pet Parlour. I brought my cat in at 11 AM for what was supposed to be a simple grooming appointment - something that takes 1-2 hrs MAX. I was shocked when I didn't get a call by 4 PM, five hours later, so I was forced to go to the store to see if everything was ok. When I got there, they said she would need another 15-20 minutes! Again, we didn't receive a call. When I asked about the delay, they explained that they had other appointments and that my cat had peed herself, which required extra cleaning.

The most upsetting part was that my cat was left for five hours without access to food, water, or a litter box. It’s inhumane to keep any animal in those conditions for that long, especially a cat who clearly became distressed. The lack of prioritization and basic care is unacceptable. I expected better, and I won’t be coming back. If you care about your pet’s well-being, I would suggest finding another groomer.

Very unprofessional, not courteous and slow service. I dropped by in person with my dog and asked for a daycare consultation. They asked me all the questions including if she was fixed or not to which I saw no. They asked me to submit my …
We asked for a teddy bear haircut for our lovely little girl and they went above and beyond for her and made her feel very comfortable ! We will be going back 🙂 …
I have a Bernedoodle. Fantastic experience, superior quality groom, happy pup, went above and beyond to make my pup beautiful....I highly recommend!
My dog still loves going every time and they do a great bath and tidy.
We've been getting our cat, Henry, groomed her for years, and the service and quality have always been great!
